dialogues.speaker: Anisa
dialogues.text: Haha, good, good! Thanks for your concern!

dialogues.speaker: Anisa
dialogues.text: The weather here's good, the environment's pretty nice, and the food's just the best. Also, thanks to Little Kumi's care, I've had all the time and energy in the world to focus on my research!

dialogues.speaker: Anisa
dialogues.text: It's just that... I guess I worry her a bit when I go running around.

dialogues.speaker: Anisa
dialogues.text: Hehehe, I actually do feel a bit bad about it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's good to see you again.

dialogues.speaker: Anisa
dialogues.text: Same here! It's always good to meet the person who saved my career in oceanography, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Anisa
dialogues.text: Ah yes, speaking of that, I've been studying the various fish species in the waters around Watatsumi Island to try to pin down the areas in which Kuntira's descendants might be living.

dialogues.speaker: Anisa
dialogues.text: And in the process, I discovered the great amount of diversity that exists among the oceanic creatures here! An unexpected boon indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Anisa
dialogues.text: *cough* Sorry, I got a little carried away. Regardless, thank you so much for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Anisa
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, she's cheered up a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Anisa
dialogues.text: That said, she's taken all these tasks onto herself... Watching her run around like that makes me wish I could help her out a bit...

dialogues.speaker: Anisa
dialogues.text: Ah yes, speaking of that... I've learned how to make some local dishes from Little Kumi in the meantime, and I've also added a little spin on them from my hometown.

dialogues.speaker: Anisa
dialogues.text: Hehe, I'm sure you'd like it!

dialogues.speaker: Anisa
dialogues.text: Wanna try some when you get the chance next time?
